required_before_physical_execution: actual released PIC GDS/PDK and process records
exact coupling gap/Euler geometry and foundry bias
PCB CAD/BOM, bond map, supply decoupling and assembly inspection
safe current/voltage/power limits, optical classification and hazard qualification
sweep rate, sample clocks, raw open-loop traces and frequency-map uncertainty
frequency-dependent signed discriminator/TIA calibration and linear range
laser current tuning response, bias-noise settings and current/temperature setpoints per DFB
PID transfer/settings, phase margin, capture and lock-loss criteria
reference comb tooth identity, CEO/repetition/FP lock diagnostics and reference-noise floor
digitizer sample rate, window, overlap, alias and PSD normalization details
exact RMS/linewidth integration limits and uncertainty procedure
replicate counts, device population, repeated-lock history and long-term stability duration
damage inspection, package storage and safe service closure cards
required_before_numerical_reproduction: source-independent FDTD/FEM project inputs and convergence
material thermal properties/boundaries and optical mode definition
digital implementation of transfer functions and frequency-dependent loop
literal versus corrected SiN density sensitivity disposition
reference cavity technology data and mode-volume definitions
